question: Can the chosen painter make a puppet we can animate, and which fast painter can match it for art made during a session?
why: Storytelling needs characters that move, and the AI needs to add new ones. Both have to work before we paint the rest of the library.
decideBy: Puppet: the parts sheet cuts out cleanly, joins back into Pip, and looks alive when animated on your desk.
Coat: it now looks far too big, with Pip's face unchanged.
Live painter: under about 30 seconds and hard to tell apart from the master style, including on a brand-new character.
learnEvenIfRejected: Whether image models can make usable puppet parts, or whether we split a single painting ourselves instead. Real speed and cost of the fast models.
reusableOutput: pip-master-v2 and the parts become product assets. The hedgehog tests AI-invented cast, and it's a usable library character if it passes.
